source: 시안 — 저장소를 만들기 전(2026-10-30) 손으로 쓴 지시문. 설계표(traits·worlds)의 바탕이 됐다
prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of the element IRON (Fe) itself — the sovereign of the Iron Nation — in THE MODERN AGE (19th century), drawn as steampunk. A female character who IS iron; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element's traits. ELEMENT TRAITS of Iron (Fe) to carry in her design and the scene: dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood. Palette: iron grey, steel silver, rust orange, ember red, black soot.
ERA — THE MODERN AGE, STEAMPUNK: the Industrial Revolution around 1860: a cast-iron railway bridge over a river, a steam locomotive with a glowing firebox, blast furnaces and chimneys, riveted iron girders, gauges and valves, coal smoke under a copper sunset. Her outfit is Victorian industrial: a fitted riveted iron corset-bodice over a bustled skirt of dark wool and rust-orange silk, iron-and-brass gauntlet cuffs, a top hat with a small smokestack ornament, goggles, chain details; muted steel grey, rust and ember accents. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
